name: Model Access (x402)
description: 130+ AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok, Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Llama) with tool calling, paid per request in USDC on Base via x402 from a local wallet, with per-call and per-day spending limits. No account, no API key.

walletKey.description: EVM private key (0x + 64 hex) that pays. Optional: by default the key created by `openclaw-model-access setup` in ~/.openclaw/model-access/wallet.key. Also MODEL_ACCESS_WALLET_KEY.

maxPerCallUsd.description: Highest price paid for one request, in USD (default 0.50). Checked before anything is signed.

maxPerDayUsd.description: Highest total paid per day (UTC), in USD (default 5).

contextTokens.description: Active context budget per request (default 60000); OpenClaw compacts the session above it.

payTo.description: The only wallet payments may go to (default: the gateway's wallet). Change it only together with gateway.
